ai_generation.positive_prompt: Single cartoon opossum wearing a tiny sparkling pink tiara, centered on pure white background. Kawaii flat vector illustration, thick black outline, pastel colors. The opossum is sitting inside a silver metal trash can, happily holding a half-eaten slice of pepperoni pizza like a royal prize. It has a joyful, chaotic expression with wide eyes, rosy cheeks, and a pink nose. A tiny banner on the trash can reads 'TRASH QUEEN' in a playful bubble font. Colors: soft grey (#9E9E9E), bubblegum pink (#FFB6C1), mustard yellow (#FFD54F), charcoal black (#2D2D2D). Clean crisp edges, no background elements, isolated on white. Bold enough to read at sticker size. No gradients inside shapes.
